content.text: Annual tuition at Hanoi's international schools runs from about VND 100 million (~US$4,000) to just over VND 1 billion (~US$40,000) for 2026–27.
Most schools charge around VND300-600 million before meals, bus services and other fees.

Fees usually go up with grade level.

## Tuition, 2026–27 (VND million per year)

Most figures come from VnExpress's comparison, which converted dollar-priced fees
using the May 14 exchange rate and rounded

them. Concordia's figures are from its own website. I added the US$ amounts myself, at roughly 26,300 VND per dollar, so treat them as approximate.

| School (curriculum) | Preschool | Primary | Secondary | Approx. US$ range |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **UNIS Hanoi** (IB) |

| 825.3 | 880.8–1,002 | $13.7k–$38k |
| **BIS Hanoi** (British, Nord Anglia) |

| 778–855 | $25k–$32.5k |
| **Hanoi International School (HIS)** (IB) |

| 613–624 | 675–797 | $16.7k–$30k |
| **BVIS Hanoi** (British, bilingual) |

| 327.9–589.6 | 589.6–691.5 | $8k–$26k |
| **Singapore Int'l School**, international stream |

| 105–115 | ~$4k |

## Main differences
- **Most expensive:** UNIS, Concordia, Dwight and BIS all reach close to or above VND 1 billion in the final grades. At UNIS, the 2026–27 tuition for

USD.
- **Middle range:** HIS, St. Paul and BVIS. BVIS is the cheaper of the two Nord Anglia schools. Its
official fee schedule notes that tuition includes school lunches, day trips, and student insurance

, which matters when comparing it with schools that charge for these separately.
- **Cheapest:** SIS's bilingual stream and JIS. In earlier years,
International French school - LFAY charged the least at under VND200 million a year

for primary and secondary, though it isn't in the 2026–27 table above.

## Extra costs
- **Meals, facilities and buses:** these
are typically not included, adding another VND10-40 million each depending on the school.
- **One-time entry fees:** at UNIS, an
enrollment fee of USD 1,750 per student is compulsory, non-refundable and non-transferable.
At BVIS,

(VND million).
- **Paying by instalment:** UNIS charges less if you pay for the whole year at once:
the annual tuition is 4% lower than the total semester tuition.

St. Paul adds a 3% fee for semester payments and 4% for quarterly payments.

Be careful with some online fee guides. Tutopiya, for example, lists BIS at about $18–28k and Concordia at about $15–22k, which is well below what the schools themselves publish. Use VnExpress or the schools' own fee sheets, and confirm the latest numbers with admissions, since fees go up most years.
